Diego: quick draft for v2.14 internal announce. change window 13:00-14:00 PT. need blast owner + canary lead.

Priya: I can send the blast. paste short blurb + rollback rules and I'll trim.

Diego: Blurb:
"Rolling v2.14 today 13:00-14:00 PT. Highlights: batching heuristic improvements, per-route model pinning, fix for streaming KV cache. Canary -> staged rollout. Oncall: Priya, Mira. Post regressions here and in #support."

Diego: Rollback proposal: sustained 5xx >1.5% for 5m OR p99 latency >900ms for 10m OR token cost +20% for 10m.

Mira: I'll own canary watch. plan: 5m smoke, 20m stability, then 10% traffic. if anything odd I'll call rollback and run `/deploy rollback target=production to_version=v2.13 owner=@Mira reason="<short reason>"`. rollback playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/ops/rollback-playbook

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary -> staging | version=v2.14 | scheduled=13:00 PT | cmd=`/deploy target=canary version=v2.14 wait=15m`

Priya: i'll hold blast until 13:30 PT if canary healthy for first 30m. final copy will be posted and pinned then. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 13:00 PT — canary id=cb-1837654322. Initial health checks running.

Mira: first 10m look clean. no 5xx spike, p99 ~410ms. monitoring traces now.

Diego: thanks team. using this thread as the single source of truth during the window.
